_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or computed here from values that were.

cpu_nodes.basis: Frontera CPU nodes the 5.3 million atom simulation ran on

gpu_nodes.basis: Vista GPU nodes that gave almost the same speed, Rizo-Rey's account

node_ratio.basis: cpu_nodes over gpu_nodes, a ratio of node counts, never of speed

atoms_million.basis: million atoms in the simulated system

ns_per_day.basis: simulated nanoseconds per day on 64 Frontera CPU nodes

jobs_million.basis: million jobs Frontera surpassed before retirement

snares.basis: SNARE protein complexes in the simulation

researchers.basis: U.S. researchers who have used TACC systems since 2001, more than

universities.basis: universities and other organizations at the symposium

vista_nodes.basis: all Vista compute nodes; GH200 is the processor for the majority

frontera_nodes_2020.basis: Frontera's compute nodes before the 2020 expansion

expansion_racks.basis: racks the expansion nodes were housed in

xeons_per_node.basis: Intel Xeon Platinum 8280 processors per Frontera node
